original: At the beginning of the twentieth century in Pogallo, an alpine pasture located in the valley of the same name, there was a great development due to the production of timber coming from the deforestation that took place in Val Grande.
translated: Zu Beginn des 20. Jahrhunderts gab es in Pogallo, einer Almweide im gleichnamigen Tal, eine große Entwicklung aufgrund der Holzproduktion aus der Entwaldung in Val Grande.
